messages:
Alex Kim: Hey team — thinking of putting together a Redwood softball squad for the summer league. Who's in? ⚾
Priya Patel: I'm interested! nights/weekends? I can do Tue/Thu or Sundays.
Diego Rivera: Count me in for Sunday games. Also can bring extra gloves if anyone needs one.
Samir Shah: I can play but prefer evening games. Also 30% chance I'll show up with pizza. :pizza:
Ellie Wong: Interested, but I'm new to softball. Is there a warmup/practice before the first game?
Alex Kim: Good Q — plan is one optional practice the week before. Low-pressure. We used a quick sign-up form: https://forms.gle/sandbox-signup (link short for posterity)
Priya Patel: Added myself to the form. I can help organize a quick skills session.
Diego Rivera: Reminder-bot: "Softball signups close in 5 days" :bell:
Samir Shah: @Priya if you run the skills session I can bring cones and a speaker for music.
Ellie Wong: Thanks! I'll try to make the practice and maybe borrow a glove. Any suggested cleats or just sneakers?
Alex Kim: Sneakers are fine for first few weeks, cleats optional. We'll finalize roster after signups and try to keep balanced teams.
Priya Patel: Also quick poll — do we prefer mixed-gender teams or separate? I vote mixed.
Diego Rivera: Mixed works. Keeps it fun.
Samir Shah: Mixed + friendly rules (no sliding, lighter pitching) — just for fun and to avoid injuries.
Ellie Wong: Sounds great. One more thing—anyone allergic to wasp-prone picnic spots? I hate to veto locations but want to avoid that.
Alex Kim: Good note. We'll avoid the west courtyard fields (seasonal wasps).
reminder-bot: Poll: "Preferred practice day" — Tue/Thu/Sun — vote using reactions.
Priya Patel: Thanks everyone — I'll send a short calendar invite once we have a confirmed practice time. Next step: if you haven't yet, fill the form. :thumbsup:
Diego Rivera: Filled. Looking forward to it.
Samir Shah: Filled + pizza pledge still stands.
Ellie Wong: Filled too. See you all!
Alex Kim: Great — team assembled. Closing thread for now, will post updates in #sports and send invites.
